VERSION 3.28.0.172

; Native sidebar Return-to-start button for infinite-canvas.
; SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
; Uses existing native resetViewport() only. No ink or pan-bound changes.

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/Toolbar.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            property bool canvasHomeAvailable: false
            signal canvasHomeSelected()
        }
        REPLACE showableToolsCount WITH {
            readonly property int showableToolsCount: Math.floor(Math.max(innerWidth, innerHeight) / ArkTokens.Style.variable.controlsHeight.large) - 1 - (root.canvasHomeAvailable ? 1 : 0)
        }
        TRAVERSE Item#toolbar > GridLayout#toolLayout
            LOCATE BEFORE Repeater#secondaryTools
            INSERT {
                ArkControls.ToolButton {
                    id: canvasHomeButton
                    objectName: "infiniteCanvasHome"
                    visible: root.expanded && root.canvasHomeAvailable
                    enabled: !root.dragging
                    focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
                    iconSource: "qrc:/qml/images/house.svg"
                    onClicked: root.canvasHomeSelected()
                    PenInputBlocker {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        enabled: true
                        manager: root.penInput.surfaceManager
                    }
                }
            }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope > Item#_uiContainer > Toolbar#toolbar
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            canvasHomeAvailable: sceneView.nativeInfinitePage && sceneView.status === SceneView.Active
            onCanvasHomeSelected: {
                sceneView.resetViewport();
                sceneView.updateScrollbars();
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
